cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18.1)
project(dsp_faust LANGUAGES CXX)

# Builds libdsp_faust.so from the faust2api-generated sources.
# The Java side (com.DspFaust) loads it via System.loadLibrary("dsp_faust").
#
# These two .cpp files are regenerated by scripts/generate.sh; everything else
# in this directory is hand-written and stable across DSP swaps.

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_library(dsp_faust SHARED
    DspFaust.cpp
    java_interface_wrap.cpp)

# The Android audio backend (miniaudio) runtime-links AAudio / OpenSL|ES via
# dlopen, so only the logging library needs to be linked explicitly.
find_library(log-lib log)
target_link_libraries(dsp_faust ${log-lib} android)
